case.description: Zdorovye Pro is a pharmacy chain bringing medicines, beauty and wellness products together in one place. The brand makes healthcare clear, accessible and convenient.
case.task: Goal: fully rebrand the business and take it from physical retail to e-commerce.

home.case1: Zdorovye Pro pharmacy branding: a 3D “pro” badge on a purple-to-yellow gradient
home.case2: A hand holding a smartphone with the learning app for managers
home.case3: A laptop showing the pharmacy chain’s online store
home.case4: Online school marketing materials on a tablet screen

case.block04: Zdorovye Pro logo: main and alternative versions and construction
case.block05: Brand palette: lavender, yellow and gradients in a 70/30 ratio
case.block06: Brand typeface Onest and the line “не просто аптека” (more than a pharmacy)
case.block07: The online store catalogue on the website and a mobile app screen
case.block08: The website on a laptop, the pharmacy interior, an app banner and the “pro” badge
case.block09: The pharmacy entrance with branded signage and opening hours, signed “designed by MESTO”
